# Credential v2 fixture provenance

`authority-vectors.json` is generated by the secS Rust
`devgraph_work_v2` fixture test using public synthetic Wallet seed byte `37` and
secS issuer seed byte `43`. These are test identities only. The corpus retains the
existing 23 Work/Arena canonical request vectors and adds generic request
credentials, presentations and distinct v2 authority projections.

The executable verifier independently recomputes wrappers, disclosures and policy
digests, then checks the Ed25519 secS projection signatures. Git provenance binds
the exact fixture to the coordinated secS review commit; a candidate fixture does
not claim real issuer authorization or installed runtime acceptance.

`progress-authority-vectors.json` adds 48 workflow/Todo vectors from the secS
`workflow_and_todo_contracts_require_exact_new_grants` test. Public synthetic seeds
only; historical vectors are unchanged. Both Python and native Rust independently
reproduce and verify the bindings and signatures.
